header: Every paper comes with a data statement
subheadline: Readers should see what a finding is based on before they decide how far to trust it.
content:
The statement sits under the abstract. It names the analysis set, the embargo and the person who answers questions about the data. Since March 2024, every Northstar paper has gone to print with one.

  • Analysis set with its own DOI
  • Embargo of up to 24 months
  • A named contact, not a shared inbox
